bagPolicy.summary: You can bring a small bag to most shows. Large bags and backpacks have to go to coat check, which is open year-round at First Avenue and 7th St Entry, and bags are checked for free.
prohibited: Large bags and backpacks (must be checked)
bagPolicy.quote: You may bring a small bag with you to most of our shows.

parking.summary: First Avenue and 7th St Entry don't have an official lot. The closest option is a surface lot behind the venue at 1st Ave and 8th St, plus the Mayo building underground ramp across 7th Street and the A, B and C Ramps a few blocks away. All nearby ramps have accessible elevators to street level.
parking.quote: First Avenue does not have an official parking lot or parking spots.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by 7th St Entry. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The Depot Tavern sits next door to 7th St Entry and is open 4pm to 11pm Wednesday through Saturday.
concessions.quote: Located next door to the 7th St Entry, The Depot Tavern is open 4PM – 11PM every Wednesday through Saturday.

accessibility.summary: All First Avenue venues, including 7th St Entry, are wheelchair accessible, and limited seating is first come, first served. ASL interpreters are available on request. To request accommodations, email info@first-avenue.com or call (612) 338-8388 at least 24 hours before the show, or by 5pm Friday for weekend shows.
accessibility.quote: All venues owned and operated by First Avenue are wheelchair accessible.

reEntry.summary: 7th St Entry hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Tickets are sold at the bar ticket window in the Depot Tavern next door. Entry is mainly by AXS Mobile ID in the AXS app, and will call is available for most events if you don't have a smartphone. You need a valid government photo ID to enter and to claim will call, and anyone under age at an age-limited show must be with a parent or legal guardian.
ticketPickup.quote: AXS Mobile ID via the AXS app is the main form of entry.

gates.summary: 7th St Entry hasn't published entry and doors details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.
